# The payload-key gaps between docs/API.md's event table and the emit sites, as
# tests/test_event_key_contract.py found them on its first run (2026-11-13). This file may
# only shrink: a new gap fails the suite and is fixed in the row or the call, never added
# here; a fixed gap fails the suite until its line is deleted.
#
# A <action> <key>: the row names a top-level key that no emit site of the row passes.
# B <action> <key>: an emit site passes a key that no row of the action names.
#
# Every B line below is a key the code passes and the table does not name (an undocumented
# payload key); the doc rows were left as they are because each needs a sentence on what
# the key means, which the code alone does not give. Owner: whoever next edits the row.
